# Terms.Law

> > California business attorney Sergei Tokmakov's platform providing 1,050+ attorney-drafted demand letter templates, legal document generators, and business formation services.

Terms.Law is a comprehensive legal resource platform specializing in demand letters, contract templates, and business formation for California entrepreneurs and individuals. The site combines interactive document builders with detailed guides on California employment law, contract disputes, and consumer protection.

## Key Topics

- Demand Letters
- California Law
- Contract Templates
- Employment Law
- LLC Formation
- Business Contracts
- Anti-SLAPP Defense
- Unpaid Wages
- Breach of Contract
- PAGA Claims
- FEHA Violations
- Cease-and-Desist
- Debt Collection Defense
- Partnership Disputes
- California Labor Code

## Core Platforms

- [Terms.Law Homepage](https://terms.law): Homepage for Terms.Law, California business attorney Sergei Tokmakov's legal services platform.
- [Demand Letter Hub](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters): Main demand letter hub with 1,050+ attorney-drafted templates across dispute categories.
- [Document Builder](https://terms.law/Templates): Interactive legal document generator for contracts, NDAs, operating agreements, and startup docs.
- [Business Formation Services](https://terms.law/INC/formation-landing.html): LLC and corporation formation service with cost calculator and compliance guidance.

## Demand Letters by Category

- [Business Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Business): Business demand letter hub covering breach of contract, invoices, and partnership disputes.
- [Employment Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Employment): Employment demand letter templates for wage disputes, discrimination, and wrongful termination.
- [Landlord-Tenant Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Landlord-Tenant): Landlord-tenant demand letter templates for rent, security deposits, and habitability issues.
- [Defamation Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Defamation): Defamation demand letter guides with cease and desist templates and Anti-SLAPP strategy.
- [Scam Protection Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Scam-Protection): Demand letter templates for scam protection and consumer disputes with damages calculator.

## Specialized Demand Letter Guides

- [B2B Unpaid Invoice Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Business/b2b-unpaid-service-invoice-demand-letters.html): Guide and template for B2B unpaid invoice recovery with breach of contract strategies.
- [Unpaid Wages & Overtime Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Employment/unpaid-overtime-wage-demand-letters.html): California unpaid wages and overtime demand letter guide with PAGA claim strategies.
- [Breach of Contract Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Business/breach-of-contract): Breach of contract demand letter guide with damages calculator and template samples.
- [Partnership Dispute Demand Letters](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/Business/california-partnership-dispute-demand.html): Partnership dispute demand letter generator using California Corp Code 16403 accounting.

## Responding to Demand Letters

- [Demand Letter Response Guide](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/respond): Interactive guide for responding to demand letters with deadline and decision tools.
- [Cease-and-Desist Response Guide](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/respond/cease-and-desist): Cease-and-desist response guide with Anti-SLAPP and fair use defense strategies.
- [Debt Collection Response Guide](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/respond/debt-collection): Debt collection defense guide covering Rosenthal Act and FDCPA violations.
- [Defamation Response Guide](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/respond/defamation): Response guide for defamation demand letters with Anti-SLAPP and protected speech defenses.
- [Business Dispute Response Guide](https://terms.law/Demand-Letters/respond/business): Business demand letter response guide for contract breaches and commercial disputes.
